issues.detail: The initial Stage 07 transport test import failed because tests/test_transport_adapters.py and the transport package did not exist.
issues.resolution: Implemented the three dependency-free transport adapters and added six focused regression tests; the focused and full project suites now pass.

issues.detail: Python 3.11 is unavailable on this workstation.
issues.resolution: Use Python 3.11 grammar parsing plus Python 3.13 execution until a real 3.11 runtime is available.

issues.detail: The approved Stage 07 live launcher could not acquire the SC2 runtime lease because owner_pid=36840, owner_port=5121, and owner_session=cmre_alenger-20260802-124748-6ee40c06 already held it.
issues.resolution: Wait for the existing owner session to release its lease, then rerun the approved launcher and collect CreateGame, JoinGame, runtime listener/heartbeat, and same-window ScriptError evidence. Do not terminate or take over the unknown session.

issues.detail: The adapter had typed ability and transport contracts but no shared explicit route catalog for the basic SC2 command surface.
issues.resolution: Added 19 fixed basic-command routes, typed grouped-unit validation, and simulator-backed move/build/produce regressions. Live transport behavior remains covered by RUNTIME-001.

issues.detail: The foundation proof had test assertions but no inspectable action-and-event replay artifact.
issues.resolution: Generated an adapter-aware JSONL replay, canonical simulator event trace, and self-contained minimap-style HTML player for move, build, and produce; the replay asserts three successful actions and the expected state effects, while the browser player adds seeking, playback, speed controls, and action/event markers.

residual_risks.detail: No live Neuro WebSocket, Bank-in-game action/context, or real-SC2 transport effect is claimed until RUNTIME-001 is cleared and G4 passes.
